entries.description: Exactly one entry for each language of the input, in the order of the input.

language.description: A language code copied from the input.

send_at.description: RFC 3339 date and time with an explicit offset, for example 2026-11-02T10:00:00+03:00, in the time zone of the language; null to send immediately.

rationale.description: One short sentence, in the language of the brief, saying where the time comes from.
